hold_reason: Refund mismatch: the signed batch requested a 7535-cent refund on order 172 (customer cobalt), but the refunds ledger has no refund for order 172 (only 170 and 175 were applied, matching Alpha's report). Paying net balances now would overpay cobalt by 7535 cents, and payouts cannot be recalled. Needs human review of order 172's refund before any payouts.
